title: Bengals "really comfortable" with background on Georgia WR Colbie Young

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bengals "really comfortable" with background on Georgia WR Colbie Young
sources.description: The Bengals used the final pick of the fourth round on Georgia wide receiver Colbie Young, who might have gone higher than No. 140 overall if not for an off-the-field red flag.
